purpose: Verify diagnostic software behavior against existing synthetic records and supplied expected values.
basis: Task scope and visible platform guidance; successful execution is not evidence that a broader activity is permitted.

actions: Table search and generic CSV/XLSX exports
Read-only navigation of existing sample summaries
Rendering null results and optional fields
Compare displayed identities with saved fixture expectations
increments.condition: The first increment has completed and its findings have been reviewed; no unresolved platform safety stop applies.

excluded: Raw sequencing downloads, generation or modification
Pipeline execution, similarity/clustering jobs and analysis uploads
Biological design, experimental optimization or changes intended to increase harmful capabilities
Deriving new biological associations or patient-specific clinical decisions
Testing hidden safety thresholds or changing terminology to bypass a safety stop
data: Existing local synthetic fixtures; additional disposable records contain generic text, numbers and small inventory tables only.
runtime: Compute workers are stopped temporarily during the bounded pass. API helpers reject unlisted routes and mutations of records outside the disposable fixture set.
on_platform_stop: Stop the affected activity, preserve the visible notice and completed work, and review the scope before any continuation. Do not automatically retry the blocked workflow.
limitations: The harness restrictions are operational checks, not platform approval, a security sandbox or clinical validation.
